title: Token-Scaled Logit Distillation for Ternary Weight Generative Language Models

layout.note: Panel (a) on the left is two stacked rows (encoder above decoder) of matrices joined by plus, times and equals signs, with a legend under them; panel (b) on the right is two side-by-side columns (encoder, decoder) read bottom-up with row names input, output, logit, label at the far left.

lesson: Draw an equation as a row of matrices with operator signs, and outline the same two tokens in two colours through the matrix and the output to show the effect; mirror the two alternatives in identical grammar so only the causal mask differs.
